name: Vaujany
description: Vaujany is a traditional Oisans village at 1,250m with facilities far grander than its size suggests. Royalties from a major hydroelectric scheme funded an outsized gondola to Alpe d'Huez (built 1980s), a top-tier sports centre (Espace Loisirs), international ice rink used by French teams, 25m pool with slide, bowling alley, and spa. The EMV (Espace Musee de Vaujany) is an immersive multimedia museum with a flight simulator. Famille Plus certified with state-of-the-art nursery. Linked to the full 250km Grand Domaine including the Sarenne (16km black run). Quiet, calm, excellent value.

overview.atmosphere: Quiet traditional village made wealthy by hydroelectric royalties. Surprising infrastructure — international ice rink, 25m pool, bowling. Linked to Alpe d'Huez Grand Domaine (250km) via gondola. Famille Plus certified. EMV museum with flight simulator.

beyond_skiing.non_ski_activities: 4-lane bowling alley next to leisure centre. Open daily mid-afternoon to late. Tel: +33 (0)4 76 11 11 92.. Snowshoeing, guided walks, paragliding, mountain biking (summer). Quiet apres — couple of welcoming bars.

honest_drawbacks: Requires gondola to reach main ski area (not ski-in/ski-out)
